articles.title: Toronto Pearson Airport X account briefly hacked by cryptocurrency coin promotion
articles.summary: Would-be travellers who checked the Toronto Pearson Airport X account earlier Friday were likely perplexed by a slew of ads promoting a cryptocurrency coin. The ads briefly replaced the usual updates on airport operations and flight statuses. articles.title: Man charged with arson after cars torched outside Liberal MP's home
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have arrested and charged a man in connection to an arson investigation after several cars were torched at the home of a Scarborough MP last week.

articles.title: Suspect arrested, another sought, after vehicles at MPs Scarborough home set on fire
articles.summary: Toronto police have arrested one suspect and are seeking another after several vehicles were set ablaze at a Member of Parliament’s (MP) Scarborough home last week. articles.title: 2 arrested, 2 outstanding in Brampton home invasion, shooting: Peel police
articles.summary: Peel police say they have arrested two people and are looking for two more in connection to a home invasion and shooting in Brampton, Ont., in June.

articles.title: Knife-wielding man on Brooklyn Bridge cables fatally shot after ignoring orders to drop weapon
articles.summary: Police fatally shot a knife-wielding man walking on the cables of New York City’s Brooklyn Bridge after he ignored orders to drop the weapon, authorities said Friday. The shooting happened when he moved within feet of an officer trying to help him climb down.

articles.title: Niagara to Toronto commuters frustrated by GO service cuts, persistent delays
articles.summary: Following schedule changes and some cuts made to several GO train routes this week, residents in Niagara, Ont. are speaking out about the overall unreliability of the service. Metrolinx says there are no changes to rush hour in Niagara as it completes important construction work, but commuters say constant delays this year have made the trips between Toronto and Niagara increasingly difficult.

articles.title: Vaughan cleans up after severe thunderstorm leaves trail of damage
articles.summary: Wednesday's severe thunderstorm left a trail of damage in Vaughan and crews are out in force to clean up its aftermath, Mayor Steven Del Duca says.

articles.title: Video shows 2 workers escaping moving scaffold during thunderstorm
articles.summary: Dramatic video captures two workers escaping a moving scaffold on a building in Toronto's Yorkville neighbourhood during Wednesday's storm

articles.title: NDP takes Scarborough Southwest, PCs win in York—Simcoe, Hamilton East—Stoney Creek byelections
articles.summary: Ontario's Progressive Conservatives held onto the ridings of York-Simcoe and Hamilton East-Stoney Creek, while the NDP maintained its grip on Scarborough Southwest in three provincial byelections held Thursday.
